evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: In this paper, we introduce Tasks over Application Manuals (TAM), a benchmark for evaluating long-horizon procedural reasoning.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance on a wide range of natural language tasks, and recent benchmarks suggest that they are increasingly adept at multi-hop reasoning.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate general-purpose prompting approaches, including retrieval-augmented generation, ReAct-style prompting, and an agent-harness baseline on GPT-5, and find that the best exact-match performance remains extremely low: 1% on ICD-10-CM coding and 15.5% on sentencing tasks.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: We construct TAM by curating real-world tasks from two domains: ICD-10-CM clinical coding (mapping medical conditions to diagnostic codes) and U.S. federal sentencing (computing crime sentencing guideline outcomes, specifically offense levels), with human-validated labels.
